caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular stone doorway with an arched top, consisting of thick, textured stone blocks in light beige with brownish-orange shading indicating age and weathering. The doorway has two large columns on each side and a prominent horizontal stone at the top. In the center, there is a vertically-planked wooden door painted in a pale blue color, featuring a wavy, darker blue vertical line running down the center. The door is fitted with a simple rectangular red mail slot and a metallic handle on the left side. Three stone steps lead up to the door, and the overall background is plain and off-white, with no other objects present in the composition.
title: Doorway at Mission San Juan
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
